question:
**Direction: Choose the word that can substitute for the given group of words.**

A place for housing aeroplanes
solution:
The correct answer is "Hangar."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 

__
 
• A **"hangar"** refers to a large, enclosed structure typically used for storing, sheltering, or housing aircraft, spacecraft, or military equipment. (एक बड़ी, बंद संरचना जिसका उपयोग आमतौर पर विमान, अंतरिक्ष यान या सैन्य उपकरणों के भंडारण, आश्रय या आवास के लिए किया जाता है)
 
• **Hangars **are commonly found at airports, airbases, or military facilities, providing protection for vehicles or aircraft from the elements and allowing for maintenance, repairs, or storage.
 
• A place for housing aeroplanes is **"Hangar."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Burrow: **a hole in the ground made by certain animals, for example rabbits, in which they live. ((ख़रगोश, लोमड़ी आदि का) बिल)
 
• **Hutch: **a wooden box with a front made of wire, that is used for keeping rabbits or other small animals. (ख़रगोश आदि छोटे जानवरों को पालने का बक्‍सा (लकड़ी का बना हुआ और आगे तारों की जाली); दड़बा)
 
• **Brewery: **a place where beer is made. (बियर तैयार करने की फ़ैक्‍टरी)
